ruleDefinitions.name: Audit Policy Tampering Via Auditpol
ruleDefinitions.description:
Threat actors can use auditpol binary to change audit policy configuration to impair detection capability.
This can be carried out by selectively disabling/removing certain audit policies as well as restoring a custom policy owned by the threat actor.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\auditpol\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "AUDITPOL\.EXE") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*disable.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*clear.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*remove.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*restore.*")))
